SELECT s.category_id AS categoryId, c.name AS categoryName, COALESCE(SUM(rev.orderCount), 0) AS orderCount, COALESCE(SUM(tic.cnt), 0) AS ticketCount, COALESCE(SUM(rev.amt), 0) AS revenue FROM `show` s LEFT JOIN category c ON c.id = s.category_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT ss.show_id, COUNT(o.id) AS orderCount, SUM(o.total_amount) AS amt FROM `order` o JOIN show_session ss ON ss.id = o.session_id WHERE o.status IN (1, 5) AND o.create_time >= #{start} AND o.create_time < #{end} GROUP BY ss.show_id ) rev ON rev.show_id = s.id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT ss.show_id, COUNT(oi.id) AS cnt FROM order_item oi JOIN `order` o ON o.id = oi.order_id JOIN show_session ss ON ss.id = o.session_id WHERE o.status IN (1, 5) AND o.create_time >= #{start} AND o.create_time < #{end} GROUP BY ss.show_id ) tic ON tic.show_id = s.id GROUP BY s.category_id, c.name HAVING revenue > 0 ORDER BY revenue DESC
